title: manager stripped by regenerated exclusions, not a separate config folder; init marks the workspace trusted; capabilities come back one at a time
what: user, 2026-09-15, answering q1 in chat. The launcher rewrites skillOverrides off and Agent(name) deny entries from the user's personal folders at every launch and keeps a manifest, so a new personal name is nullified and logged. Init writes hasTrustDialogAccepted for the workspace path. Bundled skills and built-in agents are switched off too, and anything needed later is switched back on one at a time, each recorded.
